name: timeclock-refactor
description: Conventions extracted from the WinTeam TimeClockViewModel refactor: choosing an inter-component communication channel, extracting a child view model or an orchestrator pipeline, moving a bound property, retiring an orphan message, and pairing a change with its kiosk variant. Includes a behaviour-parity auditor for verifying an extraction against the merge base with dev. Targets the MOB-13653 branch — the architecture these skills describe is not on master.
